Question 13
?

A=[116290119],B=[10027−12103]

By applying elementary column operations of the form Ci:=Ci+kC1, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the elementary column operations?

a
C2:=C2−3C1 and C3:=C3−2C1
b
C2:=C2+C1 and C3:=C3−6C1
c
C2:=C2−6C1 and C3:=C3−C1
d
C2:=C2−C1 and C3:=C3+6C1
e
C2:=C2−C1 and C3:=C3−6C1
Submit
